01Capabilities

Control that starts at the shelf.

Three things every pharmaceutical warehouse needs, in one system.

Stock by batch and expiry

See every batch, where it sits and when it expires. Picking follows FEFO automatically.

Barcode receiving, picking and dispatch

Scan on any phone. No paper lists, no double entry, no guesswork at the dock.

Traceability from supplier to customer

Follow any batch back to its supplier and forward to every pharmacy that received it.

02Mobile scanning

The phone in your pocket is the scanner.

Receive a pallet, confirm the batch and expiry, and put it away in seconds.

  • Batch and expiry captured on every scan
  • Put-away location suggested instantly
  • Works in Arabic and English
